trip announcement for you on Thursday.
The Secretary-General will travel to New Delhi in India to attend the 18th Summit of the BRICS.
The Secretary-General has been invited to speak at the open session on resilience, innovation, cooperation and sustainability, shaping the future for inclusive global growth.
That will take place on September 13.

In his remarks, the Secretary-General is expected to note that today's economic, demographic and geopolitical realities not those of 1945, and that countries represented at the summit speak for that changing reality.

He's also expected to underscore that multipolarity can help bring balance to global systems and institutions, but this requires reforming multilateral institutions, including the Bretton Woods system, the Security Council, among others, to reflect today's realities.

He is expected to have a bilateral meeting with the Prime Minister of India, Narendra Modi, and he's also expected to have bilateral meetings with some other of the officials who will be attending the Summit, but we'll share those details as we get them.
Earlier this morning, he rang the Peace Bell at our yearly tradition at the start of each General Assembly session.

In remarks delivered there, the Secretary-General said that each year, the toll of the Peace Bell reminds us of the most important consequential job we have building peace in our world today Mr. Guterres said action for peace is faltering and violence and division are tearing apart communities but where governments are failing to deliver peace he said people are showing up in other ways around the world volunteers advocates civil society leaders peacekeepers and peacemakers are doing the heavy lifting of peace as world leaders prepare to gather at the United Nations during the coming weeks the Secretary Secretary-General urges them to follow the lead of these champions of peace, adding that this is the last time he will ring the peace bell, but he will always stand with the champions of peace around the world.
Those remarks were shared with you.
And this afternoon, he will also speak at the General Assembly at the official commemoration following the passing of the late Emir of Qatar.
Turning to Nigeria, I just want to flag that our Deputy Secretary-General is on a visit there.

empowerment.
